patch.value: GH-752: list results claim completeness while unreadable items are omitted

Make list-family and SDK query results fail closed or expose structured unreadable-item incompleteness, and report decoder compatibility evidence without misattributing environment drift to item corruption.

List-family CLI, SDK, and MCP result contracts expose structured completeness and unreadable counts; strict behavior is available without token-heavy parsing; decoder version/range diagnostics distinguish dependency drift; regression tests cover pagination and all-status reads; docs and contracts are updated.
Agents and SDK consumers can mechanically distinguish a complete item set from a partial result whenever any item cannot be decoded.
Unreadable items are omitted while count, total, has_more:false, and truncated:false still present the filtered result as complete; only a warning string signals loss.
Agents can make planning and mutation decisions from a silently incomplete workspace view.
